note: Extensions for the latin-american part. The suite alias table has no entries for Mexican/Central-American fresh cheeses or for braising cuts beyond chops/tenderloin; these entries keep claim recomputation honest (dairy) and FSIS doneness enforcement complete (pork shoulder). Empty classes mean 'no allergen, no doneness check' - recorded so the scanner sees the name deliberately.
